posts.text: The stock price has seen quite a violent beatdown over the last several months. I’m invested as well and want to mention that outright. Thoughts and open questions across three parameters i consider important: (1) Change in distribution The earlier growth this company enjoyed was on the shoulders of its parent company through the SIS network. That growth had an organic ceiling, and the company had to move to other pathways to increase reach. This is what they are doing by continuing SIS, opening EBOs, and building online.
